claims.claim: The complete TASK-156 candidate remains certification-only with no production Python changes and preserves the existing roadmap contract.
The existing bounded live discovery and two-observation acquisition route is unchanged by this repair.
The existing intake, family admission, singleton variant admission, and persistent grounded-QA composition is unchanged by this repair.
